followUps.reason: Check status transitions to understand when order was CANCELLED (ev_03) relative to CAPTURED status (ev_01) and why refund was not triggered.
Check settlement batch lines to verify whether the captured payment (ev_02) was settled despite order cancellation (ev_03).

findings.statement: The order was cancelled due to flight cancellation by airline, but the gateway payment shows zero refunded amount.
The order status is CANCELLED, whereas internal payment and gateway payment statuses remain CAPTURED.

data.narrative: The order status was set to CANCELLED (ev_01), but internal payment and gateway statuses remain CAPTURED (ev_02, ev_03) with zero refunded amount at the gateway (ev_09), confirming that a refund was never initiated.
